title: Automated Architectural Visualization for Urban Planning
business: Urban planning firms and architectural visualization studios.
problem: High-fidelity video generation for urban development proposals is often bottlenecked by prohibitive GPU memory requirements, preventing local iteration on standard workstations.
solution: The Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-GGUF model provides a quantized, memory-efficient alternative to full-precision models, allowing urban planners to generate high-quality video walkthroughs from descriptive text prompts directly on local hardware without needing massive cloud infrastructure.
steps: Download the appropriate GGUF quantization level based on available VRAM (e.g., Q4_K_M for a balance of quality and size).
Install the ComfyUI-GGUF custom node by city96 to enable compatibility with quantized model weights.
Place the downloaded GGUF file into the ComfyUI/models/unet directory to ensure the node can locate the model architecture.
Construct a text-to-video workflow in ComfyUI using the loaded GGUF model to transform site descriptions into visual walkthroughs.
Refine the prompt parameters to match the specific architectural style and environmental conditions of the urban site.
outcome: Planners achieve rapid, iterative visual feedback on urban design concepts, significantly reducing the time spent waiting for external rendering services.
limitation: Quantization introduces a trade-off between model size and visual fidelity; users must verify the output for artifacts or loss of fine architectural detail by comparing results across different quantization levels.
